title: The Email — EN/ES/DE (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 102bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal life philosophy Spanish German language learning technology office
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The email began as a letter sent at electronic speed
And became a filing system for everything you'll ever need
Or not need — and the distinction between the two
Is unclear and the inbox gets broader than the view

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
El correo electrónico empezó como una carta enviada velozmente
[The email began as a letter sent at electronic speed]
Y se convirtió en un archivo para todo urgentemente
[And became a filing system for everything urgently]
O no urgente — y la distinción entre los dos no es clara
[Or not urgent — and the distinction between the two is unclear]
La bandeja de entrada crece más ancha que la pantalla ara
[The inbox grows wider than the screen plows]

[Chorus — English]
The email knows something I don't know
It knows the difference between urgent and the thirty days ago
The email marked important hasn't been opened in a week
And the one that wasn't marked is what was actually unique
That's my boy

[Bridge — German, with English translation]
Die E-Mail begann als Brief mit elektronischer Geschwindigkeit
[The email began as a letter at electronic speed]
Und wurde ein Ablagesystem für alles — zu jeder Zeit
[And became a filing system for everything — at any time]
Der Unterschied zwischen dringend und nicht dringend ist unklar
[The difference between urgent and not urgent is unclear]
Das Postfach wird breiter als der Blick — das ist wahr
[The inbox becomes wider than the view — that is true]

[Outro — All three languages]
The email knows… El correo sabe… Die E-Mail weiß
The sent folder is the truth — La carpeta enviados es la verdad — Der Gesendet-Ordner ist die Wahrheit
That's my boy
